name: 🍓 Merge a Garden!
desc:
🍓 Merge fruits together to create bigger and rarer ones! 🍓

💥 Combine fruits into juicier, rarer ones!
💎 Collect gems to speed up your growth!
🎨 Unlock trails and garden themes to show off your style!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and become the top grower!
🐾 Unlock pets that collect cash while you play!

Can you merge your way to the top of the fruit chain?
